## Goals

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

- Use a yes/no column to compare groups
- See t-tests and ANOVA as regression
- Read an interaction from a product column
- Say what adding baseline does to the standard error
- Say when a study earns the word "caused"

## Reading

- {{< fa book >}} Section 13-1, on main effects and interactions.
- {{< fa book >}} [Part 2 of our regression handout](/resource/regression-handout.qmd#part-2), on yes/no columns, two predictors and interactions.
- {{< fa pencil >}} Practice: Problems 4 to 7 at the end of [the handout](/resource/regression-handout.qmd#practice). Solutions are on Canvas.
